SSRF allowlist permits a loopback mock server while private-network protection remains enabled

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Crawlberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var engineConfig = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CrawlConfig>("{\"respect_robots_txt\":false,\"ssrf\":{\"allowlist\":[{\"type\":\"cidr\",\"value\":\"127.0.0.0/8\"}],\"deny_private\":true,\"max_redirects\":5},\"ssrf_deny_private_explicit\":true}", ConfigOptions)!;
var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(engineConfig);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.ScrapeAsync(engine, url);
Console.WriteLine(result.StatusCode);
Console.WriteLine(result.Metadata.Title);
```
